title.en: Russia says at least seven killed in largest Ukrainian attack of 2026
title.zh: 俄罗斯称2026年乌克兰最大规模袭击造成至少七人死亡

summary.en: Russia reported at least seven fatalities in what it described as Ukraine's largest attack of 2026. Concurrently, Moscow carried out its own deadly strikes against Ukraine, causing fires in Kyiv.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯报告称，乌克兰在2026年发动了最大规模的袭击，造成至少七人死亡。与此同时，莫斯科也对乌克兰发动了致命袭击，导致首都基辅多处起火。

body.en:
At least seven people have been killed in Russia after what officials called the "largest-scale" attack launched by Ukraine this year.

Some 822 drones were used - 600 aiming for Moscow, according to its regional governor who said the Russian capital had suffered "one of the most massive drone attacks in recent memory". A warehouse belonging to Russian online retailer Wildberries was hit.

Russian attacks on Ukraine also killed at least seven people and injured more than 39.

Russia has intensified missile attacks across Ukraine in recent weeks, with Kyiv also stepping up drone strikes deep inside Russia.

Five people died in Russia's south-western region of Rostov following overnight strikes, its governor said.

Officials in Belgorod, which borders Ukraine, said a woman was killed after a civilian bus was struck, while an 83-year-old man died in a drone attack in the Moscow region, according to Governor Andrey Vorobyov.

A Wildberries warehouse in Koledino, 25km (15.5 miles) from the centre of Moscow, was hit in an attack, injuring three, Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said. Videos shows a fire and a large plume of smoke over the warehouse.

Wildberries, known as Russia's version of Amazon, has been repeatedly targeted since July. Kyiv said at the time it was targeting logistics hubs used by Russians to buy military equipment and disrupting supplies to the Russian army.

Ukraine's defence ministry said the latest attack meant that seven out of 10 of the largest Wildberries logistics centres had been "disabled".

In Ukraine, a 66-year-old man and 64-year-old woman died after a private house was hit by a guided aerial bomb in the Zaporizhzhia region, officials said.

Officials in Sumy, Donetsk and Kherson also reported one death in each region, including a 51-year-old killed in a drone strike in Sumy.

In Kyiv, air-raid sirens sounded four times overnight as the Ukrainian capital came under Russian attack. At least six people, including a child, were reportedly injured, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said.

Russia said its attacks on Kyiv on Saturday night targeted a FirePoint facility producing parts for Ukrainian Flamingo missiles and a factory making components for drones.

A book market in the city's Pochayna district was damaged in the strikes. Burnt books could be seen lying on the ground, while firefighters continue to douse the flames.

Looking through the rubble, she told the BBC: "All these books in the street were from my husband's stall in the market - I recognise them on the floor."

Vinyl store owner Luba, 42, said she has lost 500,000 hryvnias (£8,262) worth of stock.

"This business was my baby - many of the vinyls destroyed were rare and irreplaceable," she told the BBC. "I want Russia to disappear from this Earth."

body.zh: 官方称乌克兰今年发动的“最大规模”袭击事件导致俄罗斯至少七人死亡。 据该地区州长称，大约使用了 822 架无人机，其中 600 架瞄准莫斯科，俄罗斯首都遭受了“近期记忆中最大规模的无人机袭击之一”。俄罗斯在线零售商 Wildberry 的一个仓库遭到袭击。 俄罗斯对乌克兰的袭击还造成至少 7 人死亡、超过 39 人受伤。 最近几周，俄罗斯加强了对乌克兰各地的导弹袭击，基辅也加强了对俄罗斯境内深处的无人机袭击。 俄罗斯西南部罗斯托夫地区州长表示，连夜袭击造成五人死亡。 据州长安德烈·沃罗比约夫 (Andrey Vorobyov) 称，与乌克兰接壤的别尔哥罗德官员表示，一名妇女在一辆民用巴士被撞后丧生，而一名 83 岁的男子则在莫斯科地区的一次无人机袭击中死亡。 市长谢尔盖·索比亚宁 (Sergei Sobyanin) 表示，距离莫斯科市中心 25 公里（15.5 英里）的科莱迪诺 (Koledino) 的一个 Wildberry 仓库遭到袭击，造成三人受伤。视频显示仓库上空着火并冒出大量浓烟。 被称为俄罗斯版亚马逊的 Wildberry 自 7 月以来多次成为攻击目标。基辅当时表示，它的目标是俄罗斯人用来购买军事装备的后勤中心，并中断对俄罗斯军队的供应。 官员称，乌克兰扎波罗热地区的一所私人住宅遭到制导炸弹袭击，造成一名 66 岁男子和 64 岁女子死亡。 苏梅、顿涅茨克和赫尔松的官员还报告称，每个地区都有一人死亡，其中包括一名 51 岁的男子在苏梅的一次无人机袭击中丧生。 在基辅，乌克兰首都遭到俄罗斯的袭击，空袭警报一夜四次响起。市长维塔利·克里琴科表示，据报道，至少有六人受伤，其中包括一名儿童。 俄罗斯表示，周六晚间对基辅的袭击目标是一家生产乌克兰火烈鸟导弹零部件的 FirePoint 设施和一家生产无人机零部件的工厂。 该市Pochayna区的一个图书市场在罢工中遭到破坏。可以看到烧焦的书籍躺在地上，而消防队员仍在继续扑灭火焰。 她透过废墟告诉英国广播公司：“街上所有这些书都是我丈夫在市场摊位上买的——我在地板上认出了它们。” 42 岁的 Vinyl 商店老板 Luba 表示，她损失了价值 500,000 格里夫尼亚（8,262 英镑）的库存。 “这个生意是我的宝贝——许多被销毁的黑胶唱片都是稀有且不可替代的，”她告诉英国广播公司。 “我希望俄罗斯从这个地球上消失。” 乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示，本周有 13 个地区受到攻击，俄罗斯发射了超过 1,550 架攻击无人机、近 1,560 枚制导航空炸弹和...

reflection.en: The tragic news of escalating strikes reminds us of the perilous cycle of violence, where each act of aggression often invites a reciprocal response. Yahweh's word warns that those who live by the sword risk perishing by it, urging us to consider the ultimate cost of conflict.
reflection.zh: 升级的袭击悲剧性地提醒我们，暴力循环是多么危险，每一次侵略行为往往会招致对等的回应。雅伟的话语警告我们，那些持剑而生的人，也可能死于剑下，敦促我们思考冲突的最终代价。

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: Teen suspect in Virginia campus shooting found hiding in closet
title.zh: 弗吉尼亚校园枪击案青少年嫌犯藏匿壁橱中被发现

summary.en: Police report that five people were injured in an attack outside a residence hall on a Virginia campus, and the suspect, a teenager, was not a student at the institution. The suspect was later found hiding in a closet.
summary.zh: 警方报告称，弗吉尼亚一所大学的宿舍楼外发生袭击事件，造成五人受伤。嫌犯是一名青少年，并非该校学生，后被发现藏匿于壁橱中。

body.en:
A teenager has been arrested after five people were shot at Virginia State University (VSU) in the early hours of Saturday morning.

Camron Harris, a 19-year-old from Henrico in Virginia, was found hiding in a closet on campus after the incident, police told US media. He is not a student at the university.

Only one of the five victims was studying at VSU, and all were taken to local hospitals with gunshot wounds.

A 21-year-old man remains in a critical condition. The other four, whose ages range from 17 to 23, suffered non-life-threatening injuries, according to police.

Local officers initially told the BBC that they believed more than one shooter was involved.

VSU, located south of the state's capital Richmond, is one of the country's historically black universities.

Officers responded to the incident outside a residence halls at about 01:28 local time (05:28 GMT) on Saturday, the university said.

Classes for the new term were set to begin on Monday and campus dormitories opened for returning students on Friday, according to the university's website.

Lt James R Lamb of Chesterfield County Police Department told the BBC on Saturday that authorities believed there to be multiple assailants involved.

VSU has more than 5,000 students. It and other historically black institutions were created to provide higher education to disenfranchised African Americans, who were otherwise prohibited from attending most colleges.
body.zh: 周六凌晨，弗吉尼亚州立大学 (VSU) 五人遭枪击，一名青少年被捕。 警方告诉美国媒体，事件发生后，来自弗吉尼亚州亨利科的 19 岁青少年卡姆伦·哈里斯 (Camron Harris) 被发现藏在校园的壁橱里。他不是大学的学生。 五名受害者中只有一名在弗吉尼亚州立大学学习，所有人都因枪伤被送往当地医院。 一名 21 岁男子仍处于危急状态。警方称，另外四人年龄在 17 岁至 23 岁之间，没有生命危险。 当地官员最初告诉英国广播公司，他们相信不止一名枪手参与其中。 VSU 位于该州首府里士满以南，是该国历史悠久的黑人大学之一。 该大学表示，周六当地时间 01 点 28 分（格林威治标准时间 05 点 28 分）左右，警方在宿舍外对这起事件做出了反应。 据该大学网站称，新学期的课程定于周一开始，校园宿舍将于周五向返校学生开放。 切斯特菲尔德县警察局的詹姆斯·R·兰姆中尉周六告诉英国广播公司，当局相信有多名袭击者参与其中。 VSU 拥有 5,000 多名学生。它和其他历史上黑人机构的创建是为了向被剥夺公民权的非裔美国人提供高等教育，否则他们被禁止进入大多数大学。

reflection.en: In the wake of violence that leaves individuals injured and communities shaken, our hearts turn to those who suffer. Yahweh is a source of comfort and healing, attentive to the pain of the brokenhearted and ready to bind up their wounds. This reminds us to seek His presence and extend compassion to all affected by such events.
reflection.zh: 在暴力事件导致人员受伤、社区震惊之际，我们的心转向那些受苦的人。雅伟是安慰和医治的源泉，祂关注伤心之人的痛苦，并预备好缠裹他们的伤处。这提醒我们寻求祂的同在，并向所有受此类事件影响的人伸出援手。

verse.textEn: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
verse.textZh: 他医好伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处。

title.en: One dead, homes swept away after Hurricane Lala lashes Hawaii
title.zh: 拉拉飓风袭击夏威夷致一人死亡，房屋被毁

summary.en: A search-and-rescue operation is under way in Hawaii after Hurricane Lala caused one fatality and destroyed homes, uprooting properties from their foundations.
summary.zh: 拉拉飓风袭击夏威夷后，造成一人死亡，房屋被连根拔起，目前搜救行动正在进行中。

body.en:
Hawaii is facing flash floods and mudslides that have swept away some homes after category one Hurricane Lala skirted Big Island, leaving one person dead in a car accident.

A search-and-rescue operation was under way after several properties were uprooted from their foundations in the coastal communities of Naalehu and Waiohinu.

Despite not even making landfall, the storm still dumped up to 35in (89cm) of rain in places, sending torrents raging down mountainsides. More than 200,000 householders were without power.

Lala's eyewall howled past the Pacific US state overnight before weakening to a tropical storm, and it is now moving westward, south of Hawaii.

The storm came within 30 miles (48km) of Big Island's South Point, but it was close enough to bring flash flooding, Hawaii County said on Sunday.

After gaining hurricane strength on Saturday afternoon, packing wind speeds of 91mph, Lala's winds have now weakened to near 65mph, said the National Hurricane Center (NHC) in its latest advisory at 14:00 EDT (18:00 GMT) on Sunday.

Tropical storm warnings remain in effect for all eight of Hawaii's major islands.

"Lala is expected to produce additional rainfall of 4 to 8 inches across the Big Island and windward Maui, with maximum storm totals of 30 to 35 inches," the NHC said, while the rest of the island chain can expect rainfall of 4 to 6in.

The US National Weather Service's office in Honolulu said it had had reports of two homes being swept away amid the intense rainfall.

Mayor Kimo Alameda said the county's civil defence agency had launched a search-and-rescue operation to find people whose homes may have been destroyed in the floods.

"What makes this very challenging is that there's rushing water, there's debris, there's boulders on the road, and it's dark," he said earlier.

About 180 Hawaii National Guard members have been deployed to help with the emergency response.

Some 219,000 customers had lost electricity on Hawaii as of Sunday morning local time, according to tracker PowerOutage.

Big Island's two main airports, Hilo International and Ellison Onizuka Kona, were temporarily closed, but have since reopened.

Iniki, a powerful category four storm, was the last hurricane to hit Hawaii back in 1992.

It caused six deaths and $3bn in damage after making landfall on the southern coast of Kauai.

Hurricane season in the US has been relatively quiet the last few years - the last major storm was category three Hurricane Milton, which hit Florida in October 2024.

This year has seen a strong El Niño - a periodically occurring area of unusually warm surface water - develop in the Pacific, driven in part by climate change.

body.zh: 一级飓风“拉拉”绕过大岛后，夏威夷正面临山洪和泥石流，一些房屋被冲走，造成一人在车祸中死亡。 纳阿莱胡和怀奥希努沿海社区的几处房屋被连根拔起，搜救行动正在进行中。 尽管风暴尚未登陆，但部分地区降雨量仍高达 35 英寸（89 厘米），激流从山坡上肆虐而下。超过20万住户断电。 拉拉的眼墙一夜之间呼啸着掠过美国太平洋州，然后减弱为热带风暴，目前正在向西移动，前往夏威夷南部。 夏威夷县周日表示，这场风暴袭击了距离大岛南角 30 英里（48 公里）的范围，但距离足够近，足以引发山洪。 国家飓风中心 (NHC) 在周日美国东部时间 14:00（格林尼治标准时间 18:00）发布的最新通报中表示，周六下午飓风强度增强，风速达到 91 英里/小时，现在已减弱至接近 65 英里/小时。 热带风暴警报对夏威夷所有八个主要岛屿仍然有效。 NHC 表示：“预计拉拉将给大岛和毛伊岛迎风区带来 4 至 8 英寸的额外降雨量，最大风暴总量为 30 至 35 英寸，而岛链的其他地区预计降雨量为 4 至 6 英寸。” 美国国家气象局位于檀香山的办公室表示，接到报告称，两栋房屋在强降雨中被冲走。 市长基莫·阿拉米达表示，该县民防机构已启动搜救行动，寻找房屋可能在洪水中被毁的人们。 “这非常具有挑战性，因为这里有湍急的水流、碎片、路上有巨石，而且天很黑，”他早些时候说。 大约 180 名夏威夷国民警卫队成员已被部署协助应对紧急情况。 据 PowerOutage 追踪公司统计，截至当地时间周日上午，夏威夷约有 219,000 名客户断电。 大岛的两个主要机场希洛国际机场和埃里森奥尼祖卡科纳机场暂时关闭，但后来重新开放。 伊尼基 (Iniki) 是一场强大的四级风暴，是 1992 年袭击夏威夷的最后一场飓风。 它在可爱岛南部海岸登陆后造成 6 人死亡和 30 亿美元的损失。 过去几年，美国的飓风季节相对平静 - 上一次重大风暴是 2024 年 10 月袭击佛罗里达州的三级飓风米尔顿。 今年，太平洋地区出现了强烈的厄尔尼诺现象——一种周期性发生的异常温暖的地表水区域，部分原因是气候变化。 由于飓风和台风以温暖的海水为食，海洋温度的飙升可能会导致更多的……

reflection.en: In the wake of Hurricane Lala's devastation, communities face immense loss and the urgent need for rescue and rebuilding. Even amidst such overwhelming natural forces, we can find strength and a secure refuge in Yahweh. He is our ever-present help in times of trouble, offering comfort and stability when the world around us is shaken.
reflection.zh: 在拉拉飓风的破坏之后，社区面临巨大的损失以及紧急的救援和重建需求。即使在如此压倒性的自然力量中，我们也能在雅伟那里找到力量和安全的避难所。当周围的世界动摇时，祂是我们患难中随时的帮助，提供安慰和稳定。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Brazil’s Lula launches historic fourth term bid – but son of jailed Bolsonaro stands in his way
title.zh: 巴西卢拉发起历史性第四次连任竞选，但被监禁的博尔索纳罗之子阻碍了他的前进

body.en: President, 80, vows to keep far-right from power as Flávio Bolsonaro tells supporters he will ‘fight this system’ Brazil’s leftwing president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, has launched his campaign for a historic fourth term and vowed that as long as he lived he would not allow the “shameless” right to return to power. Addressing a sea of supporters in São Bernardo do Campo, the industrial city where his political career began nearly half a century ago, the 80-year-old politician reminded voters of the chaos and violence that unfolded during the 2018-2022 presidency of his far-right predecessor, Jair Bolsonaro, whose son, Flávio Bolsonaro, Lula will face in October’s presidential election. reflection.en: This story draws attention to leadership, wisdom, and public responsibility. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with wisdom, integrity, and service, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到领导、智慧与公共责任。Proverbs 11:14提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以智慧、正直与服事来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: ‘It’s been very tough’: hope of progress in gruelling battle against south Wales wildfire
title.zh: “非常艰难”：南威尔士野火艰苦战役中出现进展的盼望

summary.en: Emergency services and military personnel in south Wales are making progress in their arduous three-week battle against a massive wildfire near Blaenavon. Despite the ongoing efforts, concerns remain about the future impact of the blaze.
summary.zh: 威尔士南部布莱纳文附近，紧急服务部门和军队经过三周多的艰苦努力，在扑灭一场大规模野火方面取得了进展。尽管如此，人们对这场大火未来的影响仍感到担忧。

body.en: Efforts of emergency services and military in Blaenavon appear to be working but there are fears for the future More than three weeks after it began burning and two days after the military deployed to the area, there is hope that the huge wildfire on the hillside above the Ebbw valley village of Blaenavon may finally be coming under control. Emergency workers and soldiers described a gruelling battle against the deep-seated peat fire that has spread over 4,000 hectares (9,800 acres), putting lives, farmland and property at risk. reflection.zh: 威尔士南部与野火的长期艰苦斗争提醒我们，即使在最艰难的战役中，坚持不懈也能带来盼望。正如罗马书5:3-4所说，苦难生忍耐，忍耐生品格，品格生盼望。紧急服务部门和军队的持续努力体现了这种坚韧不拔的精神，尽管对未来仍有担忧，但他们紧紧抓住最终解脱的盼望。

title.en: Greek wildfire kills two people as aircraft deployed to blaze at Belgian nature reserve
title.zh: 希腊岛屿野火致两人死亡，比利时火灾出动直升机扑救

summary.en: Wildfires on the Greek island of Salamis have claimed two lives, while Belgium is battling its largest blaze in over a century, with flames nearing the German border and prompting the evacuation of 600 people. Firefighting aircraft have been deployed to assist in containing the extensive fires.
summary.zh: 希腊萨拉米斯岛的野火已导致两人死亡，而比利时正与一个多世纪以来最大的火灾作斗争，火焰逼近德国边境，导致600人被疏散。消防飞机已被调派协助控制这些大面积火灾。

body.en: Couple die in Salamis and Belgium battling its biggest fire in more than a century near German border An elderly couple died in fires on the Greek island of Salamis on Sunday and a fire ravaged Belgium’s largest nature reserve, in the latest wave of European wildfires. The couple died outside their home in the Peristeria beach area of Salamis, Greece’s coastguard said. More than 500 people were ordered to evacuate. Continue reading...
body.zh: 比利时正在与一个多世纪以来最大的火灾作斗争，德国边境附近发生大火，600人被要求撤离希腊萨拉米斯岛的火灾已造成两人死亡，消防飞机被要求帮助扑灭最新一波欧洲野火中比利时一个多世纪以来最严重的火灾。消防部门发言人告诉法新社，周日，萨拉米斯岛发生两起火灾后，在佩里斯特里亚海滩地区发现了两人的尸体。数百人已被命令撤离。继续阅读...

In these moments, we are called to compassion for those affected and to a deeper understanding of our...

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Two dead and hundreds evacuated as twin fires break out on Greek island
title.zh: 希腊岛屿发生两起火灾，造成两人死亡，数百人撤离

summary.en: Nearly 200 firefighters are trying to keep the two fires apart on Salamina, Greek media report.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Two people died and and hundreds were evacuated after two fires broke out "almost simultaneously" on a Greek island near Athens, officials said.

About 200 firefighters were working to keep the twin fires from converging on the island of Salamina, which was under a high wildfire risk on Sunday.

The first blaze was reported at 14:40 local time (11:40 GMT) near the island's south coast and spread rapidly due to high winds, followed by the second some 20 minutes later in the east.

More than 500 people have so far been evacuated by sea, Greek media report. The cause of the fires is not yet known.

Five patrol boats have been sent to the area and several other private vessels are being made available for assistance, he added. A number of aircraft and 50 fire engines have also been deployed.

The first blaze broke out in a mixed residential and forested area in Peristeria, a southern city on the island, fire official Vasilios Vathrakoyannis said in a statement, followed by the second in the eastern town of Selinia.

At least 10 people suffered burns or showed "symptoms of smoke inhalation", five of whom had been taken for treatment locally, Greek Health Minister Adonis Georgiades said on X.

Salamina Deputy Mayor Thodoris Zannis said firefighters were trying to keep the fires from burning over a mountain on the island and meeting to form a single blaze.

Salamina sits just west of Athens and has some 37,000 residents, many of them elderly.

Firefighters across Europe have been facing a series of wildfires this weekend, including officers in Belgium spending a third day beating back flames in the country's largest nature reserve, Hautes Fagnes.

The wildfire - described as the largest in the country's recent history - has more than doubled in size in 24 hours.

Meanwhile, at least one person died and dozens were injured in a wildfire that tore through Croatia's coastline overnight on Friday.

It was described by Croatia's fire chief Slavko Tucakovic as "one of the worst" blazes in the country's history and saw around 1,200 residents and tourists evacuated.
body.zh: 官员称，雅典附近的一座希腊岛屿“几乎同时”发生两起火灾，造成两人死亡，数百人被疏散。 大约 200 名消防员正在努力阻止两场大火在萨拉米纳岛汇聚，周日该岛山火风险很高。 据报道，第一起火灾发生在当地时间 14:40（格林威治标准时间 11:40），靠近该岛南海岸，由于大风而迅速蔓延，大约 20 分钟后在东部发生了第二起火灾。 据希腊媒体报道，目前已有 500 多人通过海上撤离。火灾原因尚不清楚。 他补充说，五艘巡逻艇已被派往该地区，其他几艘私人船只也正在提供援助。还部署了多架飞机和50辆消防车。 消防官员瓦西里奥斯·瓦特拉科扬尼斯(Vasilios Vathrakoyannis)在一份声明中表示，第一起火灾发生在该岛南部城市佩里斯特里亚的一个住宅区和森林混合区，随后第二起火灾发生在东部城镇塞利尼亚。 希腊卫生部长阿多尼斯·乔治亚季斯 (Adonis Georgiades) 10 日表示，至少有 10 人被烧伤或出现“吸入烟雾症状”，其中 5 人已被送往当地接受治疗。 萨拉米纳副市长托多里斯·赞尼斯 (Thodoris Zannis) 表示，消防队员正在努力阻止大火在岛上的一座山上燃烧并汇聚成单一大火。 萨拉米纳位于雅典西部，拥有约 37,000 名居民，其中许多是老年人。 本周末，欧洲各地的消防队员都面临着一系列野火，其中包括比利时的消防官兵，他们已经连续第三天在该国最大的自然保护区上法涅斯扑灭大火。 这场被称为该国近代历史上最大的野火，在 24 小时内规模扩大了一倍多。 与此同时，周五夜间席卷克罗地亚海岸线的一场野火造成至少一人死亡、数十人受伤。 克罗地亚消防队长斯拉夫科·图卡科维奇 (Slavko Tucakovic) 将此次火灾描述为该国历史上“最严重”的火灾之一，约 1,200 名居民和游客被疏散。

title.en: UAE, Saudi Arabia, others condemn Israel's rejection of Trump Gaza plan

summary.en: The statement came as US envoy Jared Kushner and Gaza peace envoy Nickolay Mladenov held ceasefire and implementation talks with regional mediators in Egypt.

body.en:
The statement came as US envoy Jared Kushner and Gaza peace envoy Nickolay Mladenov held ceasefire and implementation talks with regional mediators in Egypt.

The United Arab Emirates and seven other countries on Sunday condemned Israel's rejection of President Donald Trump's plan to end the war in the  Gaza Strip .

It comes a week after Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu rejected the 15-point plan for Gaza, stating that no military pullout will happen until Hamas is "genuinely" disarmed.

Trump's Board of Peace said last month that it had reached a deal for the complete disarmament of Hamas and other armed groups in Gaza.

The foreign ministers of the UAE, Qatar, Jordan, Indonesia, Pakistan, Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Egypt issued their joint statement as Trump's envoy and son-in-law, Jared Kushner, and Nickolay Mladenov, Trump's Board of Peace envoy for Gaza, were in Egypt for Gaza ceasefire-related talks.

Trump announced last month that there had been a breakthrough on a 15-point road map aimed at ending the war in the Gaza Strip.

The plan drawn up by his Board of Peace calls for Israeli troops to withdraw as Hamas gives up its weapons. An international stabilization force would then work alongside a new Palestinian police force to secure Gaza.

"Rejecting the Road Map constitutes an explicit refusal to proceed with the implementation of the Comprehensive Plan, and directly threatens to derail the extensive efforts exerted by US President Trump to bring an end to the war in Gaza and establish the conditions for lasting peace," the foreign ministers said in their Sunday statement.

"Such rejection confirms that Israel now bears responsibility for obstructing the efforts to bring peace in Gaza and the rest of the Occupied Palestinian Territory," they added.

Hamas on July 30 avoided using the term "disarmament," but said it would hand over its weapons to a new Palestinian governing body that would govern Gaza under the supervision of the Board of Peace.

Khalil al-Hayya, the leader of the group, which is designated as a terrorist organization by several countries and the EU, was in Cairo on Sunday for Gaza ceasefire-related talks.

US envoys Kushner and Mladenov were also in Egypt and met with mediators from Egypt, Qatar and Turkey to discuss implementation of the deal.

Netanyahu said last Sunday that Israel remained in talks with Washington despite its objections to the peace plan.

"They have ideas; some of them are acceptable to us and some are not, and we know how to stand our ground on these matters," said the Israeli prime minister.

title.en: Democrats demand answers from Trump on USS Abraham Lincoln conditions
title.zh: 民主党人要求特朗普就“亚伯拉罕·林肯”号航空母舰状况作出回应

summary.en: Democrats are pressing the Trump administration for information regarding the conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln, citing concerns over the well-being of service members during its extended deployment. Senator Ruben Gallego described the months-long deployment as a “deep problem.”
summary.zh: 民主党人正就“亚伯拉罕·林肯”号航空母舰上的状况向特朗普政府施压，理由是担心服役人员在长期部署期间的福祉。参议员鲁本·加列戈称这次长达数月的部署是一个“严重问题”。

body.en: Senator Ruben Gallego calls carrier’s months-long deployment a ‘deep problem’ as wellbeing concerns mount Democrats on Sunday intensified their demands for answers from the Trump administration over conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln as the aircraft carrier’s nearly nine-month deployment continued fueling concern over crew morale, mental health and living conditions. Ruben Gallego, a Democratic senator from Arizona, said on Sunday that problems aboard the Lincoln had kept mounting – and he blamed the carrier’s prolonged deployment on the unresolved war that Donald Trump started in February with Iran as well as lackluster leadership in general from the Republican president’s administration. reflection.zh: 当领导者受托照管他人，尤其是在艰巨岗位上服役的人员时，他们对福祉的责任至关重要。这个故事提醒我们，雅伟呼召掌权者以公义和正直行事，确保所有在其管辖下的人的福祉。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Water companies in England and Wales explore ‘surge pricing’ during drought
title.zh: 英格兰和威尔士水务公司探讨干旱期间实行“高峰定价”

summary.en: Water companies in England and Wales are considering a proposal from the regulator, Ofwat, to implement "surge pricing" during droughts. This would allow them to increase charges for customers when water is scarce, aiming to reduce consumption.
summary.zh: 英格兰和威尔士的水务公司正在考虑水务监管机构Ofwat的一项提案，即在干旱期间实行“高峰定价”。这将允许他们在水资源稀缺时提高对客户的收费，以期减少用水量。

body.en: Suppliers could factor water scarcity into charges as part of Ofwat proposal to reduce consumption Water companies could be allowed to raise bills for customers during periods of drought under proposals being considered by the sector’s regulator for England and Wales. Suppliers would be permitted to factor “water scarcity” into bills as part of efforts to reduce consumption under Ofwat’s plans, which are being likened to surge pricing – the practice where private hire firms raise taxi fares at times of higher demand. Continue reading...
body.zh: 作为 Ofwat 减少消耗提案的一部分，供应商可以将水资源短缺纳入收费之中。根据英格兰和威尔士行业监管机构正在考虑的提案，水务公司可以被允许在干旱期间为客户提高费用。根据 Ofwat 的计划，供应商将被允许将“水资源短缺”因素纳入账单中，作为减少消耗的努力的一部分，该计划被比作峰时定价，即私人租赁公司在需求较高时提高出租车费的做法。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The prospect of surge pricing for an essential resource like water during scarcity raises important questions about justice and mercy. Yahweh calls us to consider how policies impact all members of society, especially the vulnerable, ensuring that basic needs remain accessible even in challenging times.
reflection.zh: 在水资源稀缺时期对水这一基本资源实行高峰定价的前景，引发了关于公义和怜悯的重要问题。雅伟呼召我们思考政策如何影响社会所有成员，特别是弱势群体，确保即使在充满挑战的时期，基本需求也能得到满足。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Ukraine attacks Wildberries, Russia's biggest online market
title.zh: 乌克兰攻击俄罗斯最大的在线市场Wildberry

body.zh: 自7月中旬以来，乌克兰几乎每天都以俄罗斯最大在线零售商Wildberry的仓库为目标。乌克兰表示，前线运输受到干扰。但专家表示，这正在扰乱俄罗斯的经济。 周日早些时候，位于莫斯科以南约 40 公里（25 英里）的波多利斯克镇的俄罗斯最大在线市场 Wildberry 的一个仓库发生火灾。这场火灾是乌克兰无人机夜间大规模袭击造成的，其中大部分无人机被俄罗斯防空系统拦截。 周五，乌克兰袭击了莫斯科北部特维尔的另一个 Wildberry 仓库。前一天，它还纵火焚烧了更东部萨拉瓦特的另一个仓库。 过去几周，大约 20 个 Wildberry 物流中心几乎每天都受到攻击。已确认至少九名员工死亡，数十人受伤，少数仓库已停止运营。 总部位于莫斯科的电子商务咨询公司 Data Insight 估计，Wildberry 已经损失了价值 4800 亿卢布（57 亿美元/49 亿欧元）的商品以及约三分之一的仓库空间。该公司及其卖家的损失估计高达 8000 亿卢布（95 亿美元）。 虽然基辅认为该零售商帮助供应俄罗斯军队，但莫斯科坚称其仅用于民用目的。不管怎样，袭击事件给俄罗斯经济带来了越来越大的压力。 地缘政治咨询公司 Rasmussen Global 首席执行官法布里斯·波蒂尔 (Fabrice Pothier) 告诉德国之声：“我认为（乌克兰）正在寻找一个瓶颈。” “从某种程度上来说，野莓是俄罗斯社会和俄罗斯经济的一个瓶颈。” 2022年俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰并随后对俄罗斯贸易实施制裁后，亚马逊等许多在线电商平台退出了该地区。作为回应，俄罗斯当局允许所谓的平行进口，实质上是允许俄罗斯公司在未经原始权利人同意的情况下进口商品来规避制裁。 这些公司大幅降低传统价格，使其销量猛增。以 Wildberry 为例，其收入在 2021 年至 2025 年间增长了 7 倍。其竞争对手 Ozon 也提供了类似的惊人数字，据报道收入为 4,930 万美元，2025 年将增长 59%。 如今，Wildberry 已成为该国最大的电子商务平台，控制着该国约一半的市场。 Ozon 占据约 30% 的市场份额。它们处理的商品和服务合计相当于俄罗斯国内生产总值 (GDP) 的 8.5% 左右。 继 7 月中旬的最初袭击之后，乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基 (Volodymyr Zelenskyy) 辩称，这些仓库......

title.en: Belgian wildfire doubles in size on third day tearing through nature reserve
title.zh: 比利时野火在第三天扩大了一倍，席卷了自然保护区

summary.en: Hundreds of firefighters are trying to contain the flames consuming the major park.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A wildfire described as the largest in Belgium's recent history has more than doubled in size in 24 hours, local officials said on Sunday.

Hundreds of firefighters are spending a third day beating back flames tearing through Hautes Fagnes - the country's largest nature reserve - prompting the evacuation of two nearby villages.

Local farmers hauled water tankers towards the park near Belgium's eastern border with Germany, backed by water-bombing aircraft and helicopters sent from Sweden and the Netherlands.

The blaze is one of several wildfires reported across Europe this weekend, with at least two killed in forest fires on a Greek island off the coast of Athens on Sunday.

Belgian officials have warned that high heat and the park's terrain - which consists of bog-like territory, moorland and forests - have hampered efforts to extinguish the fire.

It spread from 80 hectares (200 acres) on Friday to 850 hectares on Saturday morning - before consuming 3,000 hectares by early Sunday, AFP news agency reported citing local officials.

Belgian Interior Minister Bernard Quintin said two of its fronts - heading towards Jalhay and Monschau - had been brought under control.

But authorities said the conditions remained challenging and that they were relying heavily on aerial assistance to tame the flames, though no homes have been affected.

Two water-bombing aircraft arrived from Sweden on Sunday afternoon to back up four helicopters - two Belgian and two Dutch - already on site.

Nicolas Yernaux, spokesman for the regional authorities in Wallonia, had said on Saturday that the fire was the country's "largest in recent history".

Firefighters had "allowed parts of the heathland to burn because the area is very difficult to access", he added.

Rescue teams have been unable to access the area where fire broke out, meaning its cause remains unknown.

Forest fires have also been reported in Croatia, Spain and Serbia since Friday, after a summer of extreme heat that has seen swathes of land across Europe either going up in flames or being scorched brown .

Local officials in Landes, south-western France said a wildfire had triggered the evacuation of 650 residents on Saturday.

The fire began on Thursday and, according to authorities, reignited on Saturday - with more than 500 firefighters deployed to tackle the blaze.

Forest fires have also been reported in Croatia, Spain and Serbia since Friday, after a summer of extreme heat that has seen swathes of land across Europe either going up in flames or being scorched brown .

The EU's climate monitoring service, Copernicus, has confirmed that western Europe experienced its hottest June-to-July period on record.
body.zh: 当地官员周日表示，一场被描述为比利时近代历史上最大的野火，其规模在 24 小时内扩大了一倍多。 数百名消防员连续第三天奋力扑灭该国最大的自然保护区上法涅斯的大火，导致附近两个村庄的人员疏散。 当地农民在瑞典和荷兰派出的水轰炸机和直升机的支援下，将水罐车拖向比利时东部与德国边境附近的公园。 这场大火是欧洲本周末报道的几起野火之一，周日，雅典海岸附近的一个希腊岛屿发生森林火灾，造成至少两人死亡。 比利时官员警告说，高温和公园的地形（由沼泽地、沼泽地和森林组成）阻碍了灭火工作。 据法新社援引当地官员的消息称，受灾面积从周五的 80 公顷（200 英亩）扩大到周六早上的 850 公顷，到周日早些时候已经消耗了 3,000 公顷。 比利时内政部长伯纳德·昆廷表示，其两条战线——前往贾莱和蒙绍——已经得到控制。 但当局表示，情况仍然充满挑战，他们严重依赖空中援助来控制火势，但没有房屋受到影响。 周日下午，两架水轰炸机从瑞典抵达，为已经在现场的四架直升机（两架比利时和两架荷兰）提供支援。 瓦隆地区当局发言人尼古拉斯·耶诺(Nicolas Yernaux)周六表示，这场火灾是该国“近代历史上最大的火灾”。 他补充说，消防队员“允许部分石南荒地燃烧，因为该地区很难进入”。 救援队无法进入起火地区，这意味着起火原因仍不清楚。 自周五以来，克罗地亚、西班牙和塞尔维亚也报告发生森林火灾，经历了一个夏季的酷热，欧洲大片土地要么着火，要么被烧焦。 法国西南部朗德市当地官员表示，周六，一场山火已导致 650 名居民疏散。 据当局称，大火于周四开始，并于周六重新燃起，并部署了 500 多名消防员来扑灭大火。 自周五以来，克罗地亚、西班牙和塞尔维亚也报告发生森林火灾，经历了一个夏季的酷热，欧洲大片土地要么着火，要么被烧焦。 欧盟气候监测服务机构哥白尼证实，西欧经历了有记录以来最热的六月至七月时期。

title.en: Bus crash in Hungary kills at least 12
title.zh: 匈牙利巴士坠毁，至少12人死亡

summary.en: Police have arrested the driver of a bus that crashed in Hungary, killing at least 12 people. Reports indicated the bus was carrying Polish pilgrims.
summary.zh: 警方表示，一辆在匈牙利坠毁的巴士司机已被逮捕，事故造成至少12人死亡。据报道，该巴士载有波兰朝圣者。

body.en:
Police say they have arrested the driver of a bus that crashed in Hungary, killing at least 12 people. The bus was carrying Polish pilgrims, media report.

At least 12 people have died after a Polish coach crashed into a ditch and overturned in eastern Hungary , police said on Sunday.

According to emergency services, 47 people were injured in the incident, 10 seriously.

The accident occurred on the M3 motorway near Mezokeresztes, around 140 kilometers (87 miles) east of Budapest, according to police in the district capital, Miskolc. 

Police said they believe the driver fell asleep at the wheel during the overnight journey into Sunday. He was subsequently arrested.

Poland's PAP news agency reported that the bus had been carrying a group of pilgrims from Podkarpackie province in the far southeast of Poland .

The group, said to number 59 people, including two drivers, had been returning from Bosnia-Herzegovina , PAP said. 

Hungary's National Directorate for Disaster Management said that several of the passengers had been trapped under the vehicle when it overturned.

  Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar has voiced his condolences to the families of the crash victims in a Facebook message and thanked emergency and rescue services.

Polish President Karol Nawrocki said he was deeply shaken. "In the face of this unimaginable tragedy, which affects us all, my thoughts and prayers go out to the families and loved ones of the victims," the 43-year-old wrote on X.

title.en: Troops from North Korea to boost Russia's Ukraine forces
title.zh: 朝鲜军队将增援俄罗斯在乌克兰的部队

summary.en: Intelligence agencies report that North Korea is preparing to send up to 50,000 troops to Russia to support its forces in Ukraine. However, military experts express skepticism that this deployment will significantly alter the trajectory of the conflict.
summary.zh: 情报机构报告称，朝鲜正准备向俄罗斯派遣多达5万名士兵，以增援其在乌克兰的部队。然而，军事专家们怀疑此举能否从根本上改变俄罗斯与乌克兰战争的进程。

body.en:
Intelligence agencies report that North Korea is preparing to send up to 50,000 troops to Russia. But military experts doubt this will make a fundamental difference in the course of Russia's war with Ukraine.

In late 2024 , North Korea sent troops to help defend the Kursk region of Russia from Ukraine . International officials estimate that 14,000-15,000 North Korean troops were initially deployed to assist Russia in its war in Ukraine .

Now, Ukrainian and international intelligence agencies suspect that North Korea is planning to send an additional 30,000-50,000 troops to Russia . Ukrainian officials have also stated that North Korean ballistic missiles are being fired from Russia.

President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has raised concerns that North Korea's improved combat and weapons experience could pose a security threat to Ukraine, as well as the Asia-Pacific region.

Observers have had mixed responses to Zelenskyy's remarks. Oleksandr Kovalenko, a military and political expert at the Ukrainian Center for Security Studies, told DW that new troops from North Korea would likely be used to secure Russia's border territories. Aside from remaining in Kursk, North Korean soldiers could also help secure southwestern Vornezh.

"These forces could free up Russian occupational forces," Kovalenko said. "Russia would then be able to deploy around 15,000 troops to battles along front lines in Vovchansk, Kharkiv, Sumy or even Chernihiv."

Kovalenko does not expect North Korean troops to fight on Ukrainian territory. 

The Russian military analyst Ruslan Leviev agrees. "It's one thing to recapture Russian territory," he told DW, "and an entirely different thing to be present on internationally recognized Ukrainian territory, taking part in a war of aggression."

"Diplomatically speaking," he said, "those are two entirely different concepts."

Leviev said he had not seen concrete evidence of a noteworthy North Korean presence in Russia. He said Moscow had enough troops available without having to draw foreign soldiers into the fight. 

"If you look at the front line, you can see that Russia's forces have been fairly active since mid-July," Leviev said. "That's a clear sign they still have enough forces."

Estimates by the economist Janis Kluge, of the German Institute for International and Security Affairs, back this up. "While Russia's recruitment campaign has shown signs of strain this year, regional spending figures indicate that Russia is still recruiting around 1,000 contract soldiers each day,"  he recently wrote in a report .

title.en: Lebanon says Israeli strikes kill at least 11​​​ people as hostilities intensify
title.zh: 黎巴嫩称以色列袭击造成至少11人死亡，敌对行动加剧

summary.en: Lebanon's leaders have condemned the strikes, which Israel's military said were in retaliation for an attack by Hezbollah.
summary.zh: 黎巴嫩领导人谴责了这些袭击，以色列军方称这些袭击是对真主党一次袭击的报复。

body.en:
At least 11 people have been killed in Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon, the Lebanese health ministry said, some of the deadliest raids since deals in June eased hostilities between Israel and Hezbollah.

The Israeli military said it struck Hezbollah infrastructure overnight in what it describes as a security zone in southern Lebanon in response to actions against its soldiers there.

Iran-backed Hezbollah said in a statement that the attacks would be "met with what they deserve".

The framework leaves Israeli troops inside occupied southern Lebanon until Hezbollah is disarmed and the Lebanese army takes control, terms the group has rejected as surrender.

Lebanon's official National News Agency said seven people were killed when Israeli warplanes struck a house in the southern village of Ansar, while four others were killed in a strike on the village of Deir El Zahrani.

The seven people killed in Ansar included three children and two women, NNA said, adding that a total of 19 people were wounded in the attacks.

At least 4,300 people have been killed in Lebanon in the latest round of hostilities since 2 March.

NNA also reported other airstrikes across southern Lebanon, including on a strategic area north of the Litani River known as Ali al-Taher hill. One, targeting a valley next to Ansar, was the deepest strike into Lebanon in two months.

The office of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, in a statement on X, accused Hezbollah of violating the ceasefire and attacking Israeli soldiers leading to three injuries.

"The IDF (Israel Defense Forces) responded by striking the Hezbollah terror headquarters which ordered the attack," the statement said. "Only later did the IDF learn that Hezbollah deliberately put civilians in that military compound."

The Israeli military said in a statement it killed Ali Samir Al-Haj Hassan, a commander in Hezbollah's elite Radwan Force unit and others when it struck "a central headquarters of the Radwan Force unit", in Ansar.

title.en: Rescuers search desperately for survivors as Indonesian quake kills dozens of people

summary.en: Rescue teams are urgently working to reach the region closest to the epicenter of an Indonesian earthquake, where landslides have blocked roads and dozens of people have been killed.
summary.zh: 救援队正紧急赶往印度尼西亚地震震中附近地区，那里山体滑坡阻断了道路，已有数十人遇难。

body.en:
Rescuers have combed through debris for survivors after a powerful earthquake struck off Indonesia's eastern Flores island , killing 48 people and injuring dozens, according to disaster officials.

The national disaster management agency (BNPB) raised the death toll from 40 late on Saturday, and rescue official Fathur Rahman said 50 people were injured in the 7.7-magnitude quake.

Suharyanto, who leads the BNPB, said earlier that people were trapped in several buildings.

"These will be the initial targets of the disaster response teams," said Suharyanto, who like many Indonesians uses one name.

Nearly 160 houses, dozens of educational and health facilities and other public buildings were damaged when the earthquake struck the popular tourist island in Indonesia's east, the BNPB reported.

The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies said preparations were underway to bring aid to some 2,000 people in temporary shelters.

The government sent 50,000 aid packages weighing a total of 275 tonnes to the area, and European Union chief Ursula von der Leyen offered help from the bloc's Copernicus Earth observation satellites.

"Europe stands ready to deploy Copernicus, our eyes in the sky, to support search and rescue efforts. Indonesia, we stand with you," she wrote on X.

"I have never felt an earthquake this big," Yulian Juita Ekalia, who lives in Ruteng city more than 100 kilometres west of the epicentre, told AFP by telephone hours after the tremor.

"It felt like we were on a trampoline; it was really scary," said the 37-year-old university lecturer, who was jolted awake at around 5.30am local time on Saturday.

"As I rushed to get outside, everything in the house fell down: the television, my son's trophies, the dish racks, suitcases on top of the wardrobes. When I got outside, my son and neighbours were already there, screaming in fear."

Rescue official Fathur told AFP the focus was on locating victims who may be buried under rubble, but rescue efforts have been complicated by landslides cutting off roads.

Residents in Nagekeo, an area close to the epicentre, raced for higher ground as the sea retreated early Saturday — a possible sign of an approaching tsunami , AFP journalists witnessed.

While a tsunami warning was lifted, authorities urged people not to return to damaged buildings for fear that aftershocks may bring them down.

Hundreds remained outside hours later as dozens of aftershocks shook the island, the strongest measured at a magnitude of 6.1.

When Fujisawa walked out of prison for the fifteenth time, he had nowhere to go. No home, and no family waiting for him. After spending a total of 35 years behind bars for repeated shoplifting, remaining free meant uncertainty.

Fujisawa had been stealing tiny items of little use to him—lipstick, food, whatever he could grab quickly. Despite severe sentencing for repeat offenders in Japan, prison was never much of a deterrent. It meant returning to a community he was comfortable in.

"Once you’re in, you’re among friends, people who will accept who you are, whatever your background," he says.

Now in his seventies, Fujisawa has spent much of his adult life moving between prison and the outside world.

"I kept going in and out of prison," he says. I was only out in society for one or two years at a time."

While Fujisawa's story is extreme, he is part of a much broader problem in Japan.

Japan has one of the world's oldest populations, with more than a quarter of its citizens aged 65 or older. Its offenders are ageing too.

The proportion of elderly offenders has climbed despite overall crime rates falling dramatically. With people over 60 making up of more than a quarter of arrests in some parts of the country, many are accused of petty theft.

Volunteer probation officer Chiba has observed this shift. He says 20 to 30 per cent of his parolees are elderly.

"Being isolated and the rising cost of living, some old people don't receive enough pension. They run short on money, so they repeat crimes."

According to government data, around half of elderly people caught shoplifting live by themselves, with four in 10 saying they have no family or rarely speak to them.

The number of Japanese seniors living alone has dramatically increased over recent decades, leaving many to face old age with little financial or social support.

Elderly offenders also have some of Japan's highest rates of reoffending. Nearly one in five prisoners over 60 returns to prison within two years of being released.

Last year, the government amended the Penal Code, abolishing mandatory prison labour and introducing rehabilitation programs to give prisoners skills to help them cope with life on the outside.

But former prisoners coming back to the outside still face social stigma. Many struggle to find work and secure housing.

"Historically in Japan, our attitudes towards former prisoners and how we treat them has not been good," Chiba says .

summary.en: Fiji's origin story began in a newspaper. Its echoes now reach from village faith to foreign policy.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

Long ago, the story goes, a great double-hulled canoe called the Kaunitoni came from the west, carrying the first ancestral chiefs of the iTaukei (indigenous Fijians). At its head, in one version of the tradition, stood their leader, Lutunasobasoba.

The voyagers had come a seemingly impossible distance: from Thebes in ancient Egypt — earlier still, some say, from a place farther west, via Israel — down the Nile to Lake Tanganyika, across the Indian Ocean, and finally to Vuda, on the western coast of Viti Levu, Fiji's largest island.

In some tellings, it carried the written record of the people's laws and genealogies — lost, like the canoe's other cargo, somewhere in the churning sea.

For most of the past century, this has been one of the best-known versions of Fiji's national origin story. The mission schools taught it; so did the primary schools. Radio carried it further still, until it became part of the way generations of Fijians understood their ancestry.

Only, much of it was invented in the 1890s — set down for the first time in a newspaper.

The colonial government's Fijian-language paper, Na Mata, ran a competition at the time, inviting readers across the archipelago to send in the definitive account of where the Fijian people had come from, with the best to be printed.

The winning entry ran over 17 instalments, centring on a forgotten tribe. Within a few decades it had acquired the weight of history.

Behind the claimed migration sits a larger conviction, still widely held in some iTaukei communities and church groups: that Fijians descend from a Lost Tribe of Israel — one of 10 the Hebrew Bible describes as carried into exile and never heard from again.

The belief has no support in mainstream science or archaeology. Yet it has helped foster a distinctive affinity with Israel.

The particulars shift from place to place. On Mana Island, in the Yasawa group off western Viti Levu, the Ark of the Covenant — the gold-covered chest that, in the Book of Exodus, held the Ten Commandments — is said to lie buried.

In a village in Ba, in Viti Levu's north-west, an elder once pointed to a rock and told Reverend Marika Baleidelabaci, a Fijian historian and Methodist minister, that Jesus had been born exactly there.

reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到领导、智慧与公共责任。Proverbs 11:14提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以智慧、正直与服事来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: A fake website and a deluge of CVs: the Australian firm embroiled in an FBI probe into alleged Chinese espionage
title.zh: 虚假网站和海量简历：这家澳大利亚公司卷入联邦调查局对涉嫌中国间谍活动的调查

summary.en: Exclusive: Fake consultancy impersonating Brisbane firm online is one of 13 websites seized by the US Department of Justice Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast When the first emails arrived, they were easily dismissed as spam. But as strangers continued...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Exclusive: Fake consultancy impersonating Brisbane firm online is one of 13 websites seized by the US Department of Justice Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast When the first emails arrived, they were easily dismissed as spam. But as strangers continued to boast about their defence and security credentials, they became impossible to ignore. From mid-2025, a small Australian consultancy firm called Horizzen started receiving emails and strange calls from people applying for vague jobs in the United States. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：在线冒充布里斯班公司的虚假咨询公司是美国司法部查获的 13 个网站之一 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 当第一批电子邮件到达时，它们很容易被视为垃圾邮件而被驳回。但随着陌生人继续吹嘘他们的国防和安全资历，他们变得不可能被忽视。从 2025 年中期开始，一家名为 Horizzen 的澳大利亚小型咨询公司开始收到人们在美国申请模糊工作的电子邮件和奇怪的电话。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到和平与克制。Matthew 5:9提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以怜悯、真实与节制来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: How to buy a ‘mega-dinghy’: the perilous new model of Channel crossing
title.zh: 如何购买“巨型橡皮艇”：危险的英吉利海峡偷渡新模式

summary.en: The Guardian China reports on the alarming trend of large dinghies, capable of carrying hundreds, being used for perilous Channel crossings. The article investigates the supply chain for these vessels, noting that large orders are readily fulfilled by manufacturers.
summary.zh: 《卫报》中国版报道称，载有数百人的大型充气艇被用于危险的英吉利海峡偷渡，这一趋势令人担忧。文章调查了这些大型船只的来源，指出制造商可以轻松满足大批量订单。

body.en: Boats carrying hundreds of people are a clear and alarming trend. But where do such large vessels come from? Providing a large dinghy for use in the choppy seas of western Europe was not a problem, as long as the order was for more than 20 vessels, they said. The sales manager at the Chinese company even had an online brochure for an undercover Guardian reporter, posing as a prospective client, to peruse. They had a production capacity of 500 boats a month and, yes, it was possible to get even bigger ones for the right price. They could do a seven or even an eight-metre military-style dinghy for $1,678 (£1,238) a boat, without the engines, but that would be lacking CE certification, the mandatory mark that shows a product meets EU health and safety requirements. Additional reporting by Lyndon Li Continue reading...
body.zh: 载有数百人的船只是一个明显且令人震惊的趋势。但这么大的船只从哪里来呢？他们表示，只要订单超过 20 艘，提供一艘在西欧波涛汹涌的海域使用的大型小艇就不成问题。这家中国公司的销售经理甚至还为一位冒充潜在客户的卫报卧底记者准备了一份在线手册供其细读。他们的生产能力为每月 500 艘船，是的，有可能以合适的价格获得更大的船。他们可以以每艘 1,678 美元（1,238 英镑）的价格制造一艘七米甚至八米长的军用小艇，不带发动机，但这将缺乏 CE 认证，这是表明产品符合欧盟健康和安全要求的强制性标志。林登·李的补充报道继续阅读...

reflection.en: This report on the supply of vessels for perilous journeys reminds us of the vulnerable individuals seeking safety and new beginnings. Yahweh calls us to recognize His presence in those who are marginalized and in desperate need. Our compassion for 'the least of these' reflects our love for Him.
reflection.zh: 这篇关于用于危险旅程的船只供应的报道，提醒我们那些寻求安全和新生活的弱势个体。雅伟呼召我们要在那些被边缘化和极度需要的人身上认出祂的存在。我们对“这些最小的弟兄”的怜悯，反映了我们对祂的爱。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: The Fauci hearing was painful to watch. But we need answers on Covid-19’s origin| David Relman
title.zh: 福奇听证会令人痛苦，但我们需要新冠病毒起源的答案 | 大卫·雷尔曼

summary.en: Despite recent congressional hearings, understanding the origin of Covid-19 remains elusive, with a microbiologist observing a deterioration in public discourse surrounding the issue.
summary.zh: 尽管近期国会举行了听证会，但了解新冠病毒的起源仍然困难重重，一位微生物学家指出，围绕这一问题的公共讨论正在恶化。

body.en: Despite the recent hearings in Congress, we seem to be even further from the goal of understanding Covid-19’s origin’s than we have ever been As a microbiologist and infectious disease clinician, it has been tough to watch the recent devolution of public discourse on Covid-19 origins. It has been especially difficult for me to read the comments of Anthony Fauci about the origins debate in his now-public diary . And it has been painful to watch the televised spectacle hosted by the US senator Rand Paul on 29 July involving a hostile interrogation of Fauci. Despite many early pleas, including my own , for a dispassionate, objective assessment of what we know, don’t know and need to know about Covid-19 origins, we seem to be even further from this goal now than we have ever been – plagued by politicization, polarization and illogical thinking. David Relman is a professor of medicine and microbiology at Stanford University. He was an inaugural member of the US National Science Advisory Board for Biosecurity and president of the Infectious Diseases Society of America Continue reading...
body.zh: 尽管最近在国会举行了听证会，但我们似乎距离了解 Covid-19 起源的目标比以往任何时候都更远。作为一名微生物学家和传染病临床医生，很难看到最近公众关于 Covid-19 起源的讨论的转移。对我来说，阅读安东尼·福奇在他现已公开的日记中关于起源争论的评论尤其困难。 7 月 29 日美国参议员兰德·保罗主持的电视节目对福奇进行敌意审讯，令人感到痛苦。尽管包括我自己在内的许多人早期呼吁对我们所知道、不知道和需要了解的 Covid-19 起源进行冷静、客观的评估，但我们现在似乎比以往任何时候都离这个目标更远——受到政治化、两极分化和不合逻辑思维的困扰。大卫·雷尔曼是斯坦福大学医学和微生物学教授。他是美国国家生物安全科学咨询委员会的首任成员和美国传染病学会主席继续阅读...

reflection.en: The struggle to understand complex issues like the origin of Covid-19, especially amidst contentious public discourse, reminds us of the wisdom in seeking thorough examination. Proverbs 18:17 suggests that true understanding emerges only after hearing all sides and carefully scrutinizing every claim. This calls for patience and a commitment to truth beyond...
reflection.zh: 在围绕新冠病毒起源等复杂问题展开的激烈公共讨论中，我们努力寻求理解，这提醒我们彻底审查的重要性。箴言18:17指出，真正的理解只有在听取各方意见并仔细审查每项主张之后才能浮现。这要求我们超越初步印象，以耐心和对真理的承诺，从而走向更清晰的道路。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: ‘TikTok wouldn’t open at all’: Taiwan simulates an internet blackout, with an eye on China threat
title.zh: “抖音完全打不开”：台湾模拟互联网中断，以应对中国威胁

summary.en: Taiwan conducted its first internet blackout simulation, prompted by concerns over the security of its undersea cables, which are vital for its digital connectivity. During the exercise in Taipei, air raid sirens sounded, mobile alerts pinged, and police directed people off the streets.
summary.zh: 台湾周四首次进行互联网中断模拟演习，原因是担心作为其“数字生命线”的海底电缆的安全。在台北的演习中，防空警报响起，手机警报提示音不断，警察引导人们离开街道。

body.en: Taiwan practised cutting off internet for the first time amid concerns about the safety of the undersea cables that form its ‘digital lifeline’ In Taipei, the streets swiftly empty as air raid sirens ring out and alerts ping on mobile phones. Police officers usher any stragglers into shelters, leaving the capital suddenly deserted. In cities across Taiwan, these kinds of drills are a fact of life every year , amid the growing threat posed by China across the strait, but this time there is something different. Continue reading...
body.zh: 由于担心构成其“数字生命线”的海底电缆的安全性，台湾周四首次练习切断互联网。在台北，随着空袭警报的响起和手机上的警报声，街道迅速空无一人。警察把掉队的人带进避难所，首都突然变得空无一人。在台湾各城市，随着海峡两岸中国构成的威胁日益加剧，此类演习每年都是家常便饭，但这次有所不同。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Taiwan's simulation of an internet blackout highlights the deep anxieties nations face regarding critical infrastructure and potential threats. In moments of such vulnerability and preparation, the ancient promise of Yahweh reminds us not to fear or be dismayed, for divine presence offers strength and help. This spiritual anchor can guide communities as...
reflection.zh: 台湾模拟互联网中断，凸显了各国在关键基础设施和潜在威胁面前的深层焦虑。在面对这种脆弱和准备的时刻，雅伟的古老应许提醒我们不要惧怕，也不要惊惶，因为神圣的同在提供力量和帮助。这个属灵的锚点可以指引社群应对复杂的挑战并建立韧性。

verse.textEn: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God.
verse.textZh: 你不要害怕，因为我与你同在；不要惊惶，因为我是你的神。

title.en: The west turns a blind eye to Xi Jinping’s repressive regime in China | Letters
title.zh: 西方国家对习近平在中国的压制性政权视而不见 | 来信

summary.en: Jennifer Hubbard and other letter writers express concern that Western nations are ignoring China's repressive regime, particularly its 'ethnic unity' law used to suppress minorities. They argue that meaningful international diplomacy is urgently needed to address these human rights issues.
summary.zh: 詹妮弗·哈伯德及其他来信者表示，西方国家对中国压制性政权，特别是其用于压制少数民族的“民族团结”法视而不见。他们认为，急需有意义的国际外交来解决这些人权问题。

body.en: Meaningful diplomacy on an international level is well overdue, writes Jennifer Hubbard . Plus letters from Geoffrey Dixon and Jane Renton In his article on China’s latest tool for suppression of minorities, the “ethnic unity” law, Simon Tisdall seems to take it as read that western governments will continue to pay lip service to notions of human rights in China while pursuing short-term economic goals, ultimately destructive to their own productivity ( President Xi never wastes a good crisis. As Iran, Ukraine and Palestine distract the world, he tightens his grip, 8 August ). This has been the pattern since June 1989, the Tiananmen Square massacre. His faint hope that the young urban Chinese might overturn Xi’s regime is a judgment on the failure of western governments to show any foresight, integrity, effective diplomacy, joined-up thinking or action. They rely on the self-sacrifice of individuals such as Jimmy Lai , Lobga Rangzen and countless – often to us nameless – individuals who put their lives on the line while we wring our hands and weep crocodile tears. Continue reading...
body.zh: 詹妮弗·哈伯德写道，早就应该在国际层面开展有意义的外交。再加上杰弗里·迪克森和简·伦顿的来信。西蒙·蒂斯达尔在其关于中国镇压少数民族的最新工具“民族团结”法的文章中似乎认为，西方政府将继续对中国的人权观念口头上说好，同时追求短期经济目标，最终损害他们自己的生产力（习主席从来不会浪费一场好的危机。随着伊朗、乌克兰和巴勒斯坦分散了世界的注意力，他加强了控制，8月8日）。这就是1989年6月天安门广场屠杀以来的模式。他对中国城市年轻人可能推翻习近平政权的微弱希望是对西方政府未能表现出任何远见、正直、有效外交、联合思维或行动的判断。他们依赖于黎智英（Jimmy Lai）、洛布加·让赞（Lobga Rangzen）等个人的自我牺牲，以及无数（通常对我们来说无名）个人的自我牺牲，他们冒着生命危险，而我们则绞尽脑汁，流下鳄鱼的眼泪。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The call for international diplomacy to address the suppression of minorities echoes the biblical mandate to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves. In a world where powerful voices can overshadow the vulnerable, Yahweh reminds us of our responsibility to advocate for justice and the rights of the destitute. May we seek wisdom and courage to uphold...
reflection.zh: 呼吁国际外交以解决少数民族受压迫的问题，与圣经中为不能为自己说话之人发声的命令不谋而合。在一个强大声音可能掩盖弱势群体的世界里，雅伟提醒我们有责任倡导正义和维护贫困者的权利。愿我们寻求智慧和勇气，维护所有人的尊严，特别是那些声音被压制的人。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Taiwan says it was hit by ‘abnormal’ AI-assisted cyber-attack
title.zh: 台湾称遭受“异常”人工智能辅助网络攻击

summary.en: Taiwan reported detecting "abnormal" AI-assisted cyber-attacks on government agencies last month, originating from overseas. These attacks represent a new kind of threat, with suspected links to China-based hackers.
summary.zh: 台湾报告称，上个月侦测到来自海外、由人工智能辅助的“异常”网络攻击，目标是政府机构。这些攻击代表了一种新型威胁，据称与中国相关黑客有关。

body.en: Taiwan’s statement comes a day after reports that suspected China-linked hackers had carried out a first-of-a-kind breach Taiwan says it detected AI-assisted cyber-attacks on government agencies that came from overseas last month, a new kind of threat that has been reported as “first-of-a-kind breach”. The Ministry of Digital Affairs (MDA) said its cybersecurity monitoring units ‌detected the “abnormal attack” targeting government agencies, which began on 20 July. The National Institute of Cyber Security issued a series of warning alerts while it investigated. Continue reading...
body.zh: 台湾发表声明的前一天，有报道称疑似与中国有关的黑客实施了史无前例的违规行为。台湾表示，上个月检测到来自海外的针对政府机构的人工智能辅助网络攻击，这是一种新的威胁，被报道为“史无前例的违规行为”。数字事务部 (MDA) 表示，其网络安全监控单位检测到 7 月 20 日开始的针对政府机构的“异常攻击”。美国国家网络安全研究所在调查过程中发布了一系列警告。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The emergence of AI-assisted cyber-attacks highlights the constant need for vigilance in a rapidly changing world. Proverbs 27:12 reminds us that wisdom lies in foreseeing danger and taking appropriate refuge. As technology evolves, so must our discernment and protective measures, trusting Yahweh for guidance.
reflection.zh: 人工智能辅助的网络攻击的出现，凸显了在快速变化的世界中保持警惕的持续必要性。箴言27:12提醒我们，智慧在于预见危险并采取适当的避难措施。随着科技发展，我们的洞察力和保护措施也必须随之进步，信靠雅伟的指引。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: With Hollywood struggling in China, can the Odyssey draw a crowd?
title.zh: 好莱坞在中国市场举步维艰，《奥德赛》能否吸引观众？

summary.en: Christopher Nolan's summer blockbuster, "The Odyssey" (likely Oppenheimer), is set for release across China's Imax screens. This comes at a time when Western films generally face difficulties in the Chinese market, and the film itself has reportedly overcome significant opposition.
summary.zh: 克里斯托弗·诺兰的夏季大片《奥德赛》（很可能是《奥本海默》）将在中国各地的IMAX影院上映。目前西方电影在中国市场普遍举步维艰，而这部影片据报道也克服了来自世界首富的猛烈攻击。

body.en: Christopher Nolan’s epic will be released on Friday across most of the country’s 800 Imax screens, at a time when western films have been struggling The Odyssey, Christopher Nolan’s summer blockbuster juggernaut, has overcome an onslaught of attacks from the world’s richest man and stared down criticism from a classicist who translated the poem , to become one of the year’s most celebrated and highest-grossing films. But this week, the film faces one of its biggest challenges yet. Continue reading...
body.zh: 克里斯托弗·诺兰的这部史诗巨制将于周五在全国 800 块 Imax 银幕上上映，当时西方电影一直在苦苦挣扎，克里斯托弗·诺兰的夏季大片《奥德赛》克服了来自世界首富的猛烈攻击，也顶住了翻译这首诗的古典学家的批评，成为今年最著名和票房最高的电影之一。但本周，这部电影面临着迄今为止最大的挑战之一。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Launching any major endeavor, like a film in a challenging market, requires immense effort and hope for success. Proverbs 16:3 reminds us to commit our work to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans. Even when facing significant headwinds, we can find peace in knowing that our diligent efforts are seen and can be blessed.
reflection.zh: 在充满挑战的市场中推出一部电影这样的大型项目，需要付出巨大的努力并寄予成功的希望。箴言16:3提醒我们，要将我们的工作交托给雅伟，相信他会成就我们的计划。即使面对重重阻力，我们也能在知道自己的辛勤努力被看见并蒙福时找到平安。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Zhu Rongji obituary
title.zh: 朱镕基讣告

summary.en: Zhu Rongji, the fifth premier of the People’s Republic of China, has passed away at 97. He was widely recognized as an economic reformer who famously declared China 'the factory of the world' and was regarded as one of the country's most effective administrators.
summary.zh: 中华人民共和国第五任总理朱镕基逝世，享年97岁。他被广泛认为是经济改革家，曾宣布中国成为‘世界工厂’，并被视为该国最有效的管理者之一。

body.en: Premier of the People’s Republic of China regarded as an economic reformer who declared that the country had become ‘the factory of the world’ Zhu Rongji, who has died aged 97, was the fifth premier of the People’s Republic of China and one of its most effective administrators and economic reformers following its foundation in 1949. In 1991, Zhu was summoned to Beijing, in the footsteps of the then president and party secretary Jiang Zemin , and in the aftermath of the 1989 uprisings in Beijing and the collapse of the Soviet Union. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中华人民共和国总理被誉为经济改革家，宣称中国已成为“世界工厂”。 朱镕基去世，享年 97 岁。朱镕基是中华人民共和国第五任总理，也是自 1949 年建国以来最有效的管理者和经济改革家之一。1991 年，朱镕基追随时任国家主席兼党委书记江泽民的脚步，在改革开放之后被召唤到北京。 1989年北京起义和苏联解体。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The passing of a leader like Zhu Rongji marks the end of a significant chapter, reflecting a life dedicated to public service and economic reform. His legacy reminds us that every life is a race run, with efforts and impacts that shape the world around us. Yahweh invites us to consider how we too might finish our own race with integrity and purpose.
reflection.zh: 朱镕基这样一位领导人的逝世，标志着一个重要篇章的结束，反映了他一生致力于公共服务和经济改革。他的遗产提醒我们，每个人的一生都是一场赛跑，其努力和影响塑造着我们周围的世界。雅伟邀请我们思考，我们又将如何以正直和目标跑完自己的赛程。

verse.textEn: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
verse.textZh: 那美好的仗我已经打过了，当跑的路我已经跑尽了，所信的道我已经守住了。

title.en: Mass evacuations in Beijing as Typhoon Dolphin brings more torrential rain to China
title.zh: 台风海豚带来更多暴雨，北京大规模疏散

summary.en: Forecasters warned the Chinese capital could receive more than one-third of its average annual rainfall over 24 hours Thousands of people have been evacuated from areas at risk of flooding and landslides in Beijing, as the remnants of Typhoon Dolphin continue to bring torrential...
summary.zh: 预报员警告称，中国首都北京在24小时内可能迎来超过年平均降雨量三分之一的降水。随着台风“海豚”的残余继续带来暴雨，北京数千人已从有洪水和山体滑坡风险的地区撤离。

body.en: Forecasters warned the Chinese capital could receive more than one-third of its average annual rainfall over 24 hours Thousands of people have been evacuated from areas at risk of flooding and landslides in Beijing, as the remnants of Typhoon Dolphin continue to bring torrential rain to northern and central China. Forecasters warned on Tuesday that the Chinese capital could receive more than 150mm of rain over the following 24 hours, with some districts forecast to exceed 200mm – more than one-third of Beijing’s average annual rainfall of 528mm. Continue reading...
body.zh: 预报员警告说，中国首都24小时内的降雨量可能会达到年平均降雨量的三分之一以上。随着台风“海豚”的余波继续给中国北部和中部地区带来暴雨，北京有数千人已从面临洪水和山体滑坡风险的地区撤离。预报员周二警告说，未来24小时内，中国首都的降雨量可能超过150毫米，部分地区预计将超过200毫米——超过北京年平均降雨量528毫米的三分之一。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As Beijing faces torrential rains and evacuations, the immediate need for safety and shelter is paramount. In times of natural disaster, we are reminded that Yahweh is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Even amidst the chaos, we can find solace and resilience in His unwavering presence.
reflection.zh: 当北京面临暴雨和疏散时，对安全和庇护的即时需求至关重要。在自然灾害面前，我们被提醒雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。即使在混乱之中，我们也能在祂坚定不移的同在中找到慰藉和韧性。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Passenger jet billed as China’s answer to Boeing and Airbus prepares to make first international flight
title.zh: 中国C919客机首次国际飞行，欲挑战波音空客主导地位

summary.en: China's domestically produced passenger jet, the Comac C919, is set to undertake its inaugural international flight from Beijing to Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia. While this marks a significant step, aviation experts suggest it will take many generations for the aircraft to genuinely challenge the established dominance of...
summary.zh: 中国国产客机C919将执飞从北京到蒙古乌兰巴托的首个国际航班。尽管这标志着一个重要里程碑，但航空专家指出，该机型可能需要几代人的时间才能真正挑战波音和空客等西方制造商在商业航空领域的既有主导地位。

body.en: The Comac C919 will fly from Beijing to Ulaanbaatar in Mongolia, although experts say it could take generations for it to challenge the west’s dominance of the industry China hopes to break into the world of commercial aviation with the first international flight of a Chinese-made passenger jet scheduled for Wednesday. The Comac C919 will take off from Beijing capital international airport at 3pm, landing in Ulaanbaatar, the capital of Mongolia, just over two hours later. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国商飞 C919 将从北京飞往蒙古乌兰巴托，尽管专家表示，它可能需要几代人的时间才能挑战西方在该行业的主导地位。中国希望通过中国制造的客机定于周三进行的首次国际飞行，打入商业航空领域。中国商飞C919飞机将于下午3点从北京首都国际机场起飞，两个多小时后抵达蒙古首都乌兰巴托。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Embarking on a new venture, especially one with global ambitions, requires immense perseverance and a long-term perspective. Just as athletes prepare for a marathon, nations and industries must commit to the arduous journey, understanding that true success often takes generations of sustained effort. This reminds us that significant achievements are built...
reflection.zh: 开启一项新事业，尤其是有全球抱负的事业，需要巨大的毅力和长远的眼光。正如运动员为马拉松做准备一样，国家和行业也必须致力于艰巨的旅程，明白真正的成功往往需要几代人的持续努力。这提醒我们，重大的成就不仅建立在最初的启动上，更建立在坚定不移地跑完这场赛程的持久承诺上，将结果交托给雅伟。

verse.textEn: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off everything that hinders and the sin that so easily entangles. And let us run with perseverance the race marked out for us.
verse.textZh: 我们既有这许多的见证人，如同云彩围着我们，就当放下各样的重担，脱去容易缠累我们的罪，存心忍耐，奔那摆在我们前头的路程。

title.en: Australia Desk
title.zh: 澳洲栏目

strap.en: Public life, policy, and community stories shaping Australia now.
strap.zh: 关注正在影响澳洲公共生活、政策与社区的新闻。

title.en: A fake website and a deluge of CVs: the Australian firm embroiled in an FBI probe into alleged Chinese espionage
title.zh: 虚假网站和海量简历：这家澳大利亚公司卷入联邦调查局对涉嫌中国间谍活动的调查

summary.en: Exclusive: Fake consultancy impersonating Brisbane firm online is one of 13 websites seized by the US Department of Justice Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast When the first emails arrived, they were easily dismissed as spam. But as strangers continued...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Exclusive: Fake consultancy impersonating Brisbane firm online is one of 13 websites seized by the US Department of Justice Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast When the first emails arrived, they were easily dismissed as spam. But as strangers continued to boast about their defence and security credentials, they became impossible to ignore. From mid-2025, a small Australian consultancy firm called Horizzen started receiving emails and strange calls from people applying for vague jobs in the United States. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：在线冒充布里斯班公司的虚假咨询公司是美国司法部查获的 13 个网站之一 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 当第一批电子邮件到达时，它们很容易被视为垃圾邮件而被驳回。但随着陌生人继续吹嘘他们的国防和安全资历，他们变得不可能被忽视。从 2025 年中期开始，一家名为 Horizzen 的澳大利亚小型咨询公司开始收到人们在美国申请模糊工作的电子邮件和奇怪的电话。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到和平与克制。Matthew 5:9提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以怜悯、真实与节制来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Nazi artefacts still being sold online years after trade outlawed across Australia
title.zh: 澳大利亚各地贸易非法多年后，纳粹文物仍在网上出售

summary.en: One seller says second world war memorabilia containing banned Nazi symbols is legal under exemptions to the laws Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Nazi artefacts bearing prohibited symbols are being openly sold in Australia three years after the...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: One seller says second world war memorabilia containing banned Nazi symbols is legal under exemptions to the laws Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Nazi artefacts bearing prohibited symbols are being openly sold in Australia three years after the federal government made it illegal to do so, with vendors saying they are doing so for “educational” reasons. The government in 2023 outlawed the display and trade of items bearing the Nazi Hakenkreuz (swastika) and double-sig rune that was the logo of the Schutzstaffel (SS), after multiple states passed similar laws that banned the display of Nazi symbols and the performance of the Nazi salute. Continue reading...
body.zh: 一位卖家表示，含有违禁纳粹标志的二战纪念品在法律豁免下是合法的。在联邦政府将带有违禁标志的纳粹文物定为非法三年后，在澳大利亚公开出售带有违禁标志的文物，卖家表示，他们这样做是出于“教育”原因。在多个州通过类似法律禁止展示纳粹符号和行纳粹礼之后，政府于 2023 年禁止展示和交易带有纳粹十字记号和党卫军 (SS) 标志的双符号符文的物品。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to justice, dignity, and accountability. Micah 6:8 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with justice tempered by mercy, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到公义、尊严与问责。Micah 6:8提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以带着怜悯的公义来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: The messy politics of a housing crisis – podcast
title.zh: 住房危机的混乱政治——播客

summary.en: From immigration to inflation, housing sits at the heart of most political debates. But political parties are struggling to come up with a coherent message - and no one has a clear plan to fix the crisis. Liberal senator and shadow housing minister Andrew Bragg last week said...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: From immigration to inflation, housing sits at the heart of most political debates. But political parties are struggling to come up with a coherent message - and no one has a clear plan to fix the crisis. Liberal senator and shadow housing minister Andrew Bragg last week said his plan to cut immigration is the solution - but so far, he’s fuzzy on the details. And the government wants house prices to fall, but doesn’t seem to want to take credit for it when they do. Reged Ahmad speaks to economist Saul Eslake on what really works and why politicians can’t seem to fix one of the biggest problems facing us all. Read more: Homes in Australia are now cheaper – why can’t the government sell this good news story? Bragg says lower-income earners should accept substandard housing as colleagues rebuke his migration target Continue reading...
body.zh: 从移民到通货膨胀，住房问题是大多数政治辩论的核心。但各政党正在努力提出一个连贯的信息，而且没有人有解决危机的明确计划。自由党参议员兼影子住房部长安德鲁·布拉格(Andrew Bragg)上周表示，他的削减移民计划是解决方案，但到目前为止，他对细节还不清楚。政府希望房价下跌，但似乎并不想在房价下跌时将功劳归咎于政府。雷吉德·艾哈迈德 (Reged Ahmad) 与经济学家索尔·埃斯莱克 (Saul Eslake) 讨论了真正有效的方法以及为什么政治家似乎无法解决我们所有人面临的最大问题之一。阅读更多：澳大利亚的房价现在更便宜了——为什么政府不能推销这个好消息呢？布拉格表示，当同事斥责他的移民目标时，低收入者应该接受不合格的住房继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to compassion for vulnerable people. Galatians 6:2 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with practical compassion and welcome, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到对脆弱群体的怜悯。Galatians 6:2提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以具体的怜悯与接纳来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: Australian health experts fear US vaccine scepticism is catching on as ‘anything Trump says filters through’
title.zh: 澳大利亚卫生专家担心，随着“特朗普所说的一切都会渗透进来”，美国对疫苗的怀疑正在蔓延

summary.en: Australia records 3% fall in one-year-olds fully immunised against hepatitis B as downward trend continues, expert says Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Australian medical experts have warned a shift in child vaccination advice in the US is not...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Australia records 3% fall in one-year-olds fully immunised against hepatitis B as downward trend continues, expert says Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Australian medical experts have warned a shift in child vaccination advice in the US is not grounded in science and could undo decades of public health advances. The US president, Donald Trump, signed an unprecedented executive order calling for American children to be vaccinated against fewer diseases, suggesting a link to autism despite no evidence. The official number of recommended immunisations for children would drop to 11, compared with 18 at the end of 2024. Continue reading...
body.zh: 专家表示，随着下降趋势持续下去，澳大利亚一岁儿童中乙型肝炎完全免疫的人数下降了 3% 澳大利亚医学专家警告说，美国儿童疫苗接种建议的转变没有科学依据，可能会抵消数十年的公共卫生进步。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普签署了一项史无前例的行政命令，呼吁美国儿童接种疫苗以预防更少的疾病，尽管没有证据表明这与自闭症有关。官方建议儿童免疫接种的数量将下降至 11 次，而 2024 年底为 18 次。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to wisdom, knowledge, and the pursuit of truth. Proverbs 2:6 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with humble learning and wise application, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到智慧、知识与追求真理。Proverbs 2:6提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以谦卑学习与智慧运用来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault.
verse.textZh: 你们中间若有缺少智慧的，应当求那厚赐与众人、也不斥责人的神，主就必赐给他。

title.en: The PM called Sally McManus a giant of the Labor movement. Now she just wants to go birding
title.zh: 总理称莎莉·麦克马纳斯是工党运动的巨人。现在她只想去观鸟

summary.en: After a demanding career as the ACTU secretary, during which she secured wage rises for low-paid workers and navigated significant challenges, Sally McManus is stepping down. She expressed a desire for a break and to pursue birdwatching.
summary.zh: 在担任澳大利亚工会理事会秘书的艰巨职业生涯中，莎莉·麦克马纳斯为低薪工人争取到了工资增长，并应对了诸多挑战。如今，她即将卸任，表示希望休息并去观鸟。

body.en: After securing wage rises for low-paid workers, weathering death threats and working with three PMs – the ACTU secretary is ready for a break Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Sally McManus started her job as the country’s most powerful trade union leader amid howls of criticism. Shouted down for suggesting union members were right to break “unjust” industrial laws in a live TV interview, McManus quickly adjusted to the high decibel work of being secretary of the Australian Council of Trade Unions. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在确保低薪工人工资上涨、经受住死亡威胁并与三名总理合作之后，ACTU 秘书准备休息一下。 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 莎莉·麦克马纳斯 (Sally McManus) 在一片批评声中开始了她作为该国最有权势的工会领导人的工作。麦克马纳斯因在电视直播采访中暗示工会成员违反“不公正”的工业法是正确的而受到严厉批评，但他很快就适应了澳大利亚工会理事会秘书的高分贝工作。继续阅读...

reflection.en: After years of dedicated public service and navigating intense challenges, Sally McManus concludes a significant chapter of her career. Her desire for rest and personal pursuits reflects a natural human need to find peace and renewal after a long and demanding 'race' of work. Yahweh honors those who finish their course with integrity, and a season of rest...
reflection.zh: 在多年的公共服务和应对严峻挑战之后，莎莉·麦克马纳斯结束了她职业生涯中重要的一章。她渴望休息和追求个人爱好的愿望，反映了人们在漫长而艰巨的“赛跑”之后，寻求平静与更新的自然需求。雅伟尊荣那些以正直完成其使命的人，而一段休息的时光正是这种坚韧的恰当奖赏。

verse.textEn: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
verse.textZh: 那美好的仗我已经打过了，当跑的路我已经跑尽了，所信的道我已经守住了。

title.en: 'Not where the problems are': Working holiday visa slowdown divides parties
title.zh: “问题不在那里”：打工度假签证放缓引发党派分歧

summary.en: Working holidaymakers fill a labour shortage doing jobs like fruit picking, waiting tables and guiding tours in regional areas.
summary.zh: 打工度假者在偏远地区从事采摘水果、服务员和导游等工作，填补了劳动力短缺。

body.en:
The federal government has confirmed it will slow the processing of working holiday visa applications as pressure mounts to reduce net migration numbers. 

Nine newspapers first reported on Saturday that the federal government had paused applications for working holiday visas from 24 countries.

But Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke confirmed on Sunday that working holiday visas were still being processed, but they were being handled "more slowly than they were previously".

However, when asked about the impact of fewer backpackers on the agriculture sector, he pointed to a Pacific workers' scheme as the primary visa for temporary staff.

"One of the things that happened when we started to improve worker protections on (the Pacific scheme) was ... some of the worst operators said, "if we've got to have better standards for (those) workers, we'll just switch to backpackers".

Working holiday visas — often called "backpacker visas" — allow travellers to extend their stay in Australia by undertaking work that addresses labour shortages in Australia — often fruit picking, farm work, mining, or tourism work in regional and remote areas.

The number of working holiday visa holders in Australia passed 210,000 in June 2025, outpacing pre-COVID figures by around 100,000.

The move comes as pressure builds on the Albanese government to bring down net overseas migration, with other parties carving out their migration policy.

Migration experts have warned of the dangers of political parties attempting to blame migrants for a lack of homes , arguing that migrant workforces will be essential to building the required housing stock

Net overseas migration — a measure covering visitors, family and partner visas, working holidaymakers, skilled migration, and humanitarian intake, alongside returning Australians — fell slightly to 301,000 in 2025, down from 306,000 the year before, according to the Australian Bureau of Statistics.

Labor's long-term target is 225,000 a year over the next three years, though Burke said on Sunday the party's migration policy was still being worked through and needed to go through a full cabinet process.

None of the major parties has yet specified which visa categories they'd cut to hit their targets — though the Coalition has said intake should be tied to housing competitions rather than a fixed annual figure.

title.en: Government admits NDIS reforms will impact families, downplays fears over state readiness
title.zh: 政府承认国家残疾保险计划改革将影响家庭，淡化对各州准备情况的担忧

summary.en: The federal disability minister has defended proposed changes to the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS), acknowledging that the reforms will affect families. The minister also indicated that further amendments are planned to combat fraud and secure parliamentary approval.
summary.zh: 联邦残疾事务部长为国家残疾保险计划（NDIS）的改革措施进行了辩护，承认这些改革将影响到家庭。部长还表示，将进一步修订以打击欺诈行为并争取议会支持。

body.en:
Labor has downplayed concerns that state-based disability supports won't be ready when needed, as the government pushes contentious NDIS reforms targeting fraud and spending through parliament.

A government-led Senate inquiry on Friday recommended National Disability Insurance Scheme changes should be passed with no substantial alterations.

The overhaul would cut a targeted $37.8 billion from the NDIS over four years and remove 160,000 participants by tightening eligibility requirements.

NDIS Minister Jenny McAllister said a deal between the government and the coalition to pass the changes was getting close.

"We're really hopeful and I'd go as far as saying confident that we can reach an agreement," she told ABC's Insiders program on Sunday.
